data.long_meaning: In Greek mythology, Guinna is a variant of the name Aphrodite, the goddess of love, beauty, and pleasure. The name Guinna symbolizes joy, delight, and the beauty of the natural world. The name Guinna carries the meaning “Joy, delight” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Guinna usually hope their child will grow to embody joy, delight and live with faith, good character and purpose.
